title: Add console composer and status controls to issue detail
description: Add a normal comment composer and an allowed-transition status control to issue detail, using the validated write API. When a blocked issue awaits an agent reply, a normal comment must resume its saved conversation as specified by the router; otherwise it remains a normal visible Kanbus comment. Render pending/error/success states and confirm updates arrive via realtime or Git fallback.
